title: Character Sheet from an existing character - one or more base images in
description: The Character Sheet takes a prompt only (MPI-504 v1). Add the deferred v2 path: the user feeds one or more images of a character they already have, and the sheet (3/4 close-up, front, back) comes back as THAT character. Bench first; the back view is the risky step. Brief: brief.md.
